purpose.summary: This batch program is part of the JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (claims) software system. It aggregates and tallies point scores (診療区分別点数集計) by medical treatment category for hospital admission receipts, reading from multiple indexed ISAM files (RECE82, RECE84, RECE85, RECE8A, RECE8B) and writing summarised results. It appears to handle both outpatient and inpatient billing data, including special processing for room charges, drip infusion, and residual/expired items.
purpose.domain: healthcare / medical billing (Japanese national health insurance claims processing)

Japanese EUC/Shift-JIS encoded comments (decoded as latin-1, hence garbled in display)
33 CALL statements suggesting modular design with external subprograms

Error file (RECEERR-FILE) for logging processing errors
No COMP-3 packed decimal usage despite numeric-heavy processing
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — file I/O only via ISAM indexed files
verdict.notes: The file was decoded with latin-1 but the comments contain Japanese text (likely EUC-JP or Shift-JIS), which appears garbled. The COPY statements reference external copybooks (.INC files) that are not included in this excerpt, so the full record layouts are not visible. The program is clearly part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system used widely in Japanese clinics. The copy_count reported as 0 by the mechanical indicator is likely because the COPY statements reference .INC files rather than standard .cpy extensions, or the tool did not count them.
